label: Даты и этажи
description: A 10-sentence card for ordinal numerals in dates, floors and order.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Date in nominative. A bare date naming the day uses the neuter nominative ordinal 'первое', agreeing with the implied neuter 'число'; the month stays in the genitive.
Strategic focus: Genitive date rule. To say when something happened, the ordinal goes into the genitive: 'третьего' shows the soft-stem genitive -ьего, and 'марта' stays genitive for the month.
Strategic focus: Floor in prepositional. Floors use 'на' plus the prepositional case; 'пятом' agrees with masculine 'этаже' in the prepositional singular.
Strategic focus: Order in prepositional. Position in a row uses 'в' plus prepositional; 'первом' agrees with masculine 'ряду' in the prepositional singular.
Strategic focus: Genitive future date. Only the last word of a compound ordinal declines: 'второго' takes the genitive while 'двадцать' stays fixed, and 'июня' remains genitive.
Strategic focus: Soft-stem floor. The soft ordinal 'третий' becomes 'третьем' in the masculine prepositional, agreeing with 'этаже' after 'на'.
Strategic focus: Naming a date. The named day takes the neuter nominative 'восьмое' for the implied 'число', while 'марта' stays in the genitive.
Strategic focus: Genitive birth date. 'When' a person was born uses the genitive ordinal 'второго' plus genitive month 'сентября', following the standard date rule.
Strategic focus: Platform in prepositional. 'Четвёртом' agrees with masculine 'пути' in the prepositional after 'на'; note the ё kept in the stem.
Strategic focus: Genitive past date. The completed event takes the genitive ordinal 'девятого' with the genitive month 'мая', expressing the day on which it occurred.
